Row C1 (eci_no -> lgd_ac_id migration) adds the additive nullable lgd_ac_id field at v4.2 per ADR-0049. The field is optional, so the many in-tree SoT constituencies.json files still declaring $schema_version 4.1 remain valid against the current 4.2 schema and are not mechanically restamped (reader-before-writer, ADR-0047): both versions are accepted until each state's SoT is touched to carry verified LGD codes.
